smiles.title: Smiles
smiles.description: De-novo mask [*{minimum-maximum}], with 1 <= minimum <= maximum <= 512. The adapter passes floor((minimum + maximum) / 2) as upstream min_add_len, a minimum number of SAFE mask tokens; [*{10-20}] therefore reports minimum_mask_tokens=15. Upstream samples token length from its empirical distribution above that minimum. Neither endpoint is a heavy-atom bound, and maximum is not a maximum token or molecular-size limit. Measure and filter heavy-atom counts on returned SMILES separately if required.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Molecule scoring function (case-insensitive QED or LogP).

noise.description: Finite nonnegative sampling noise; numeric strings are also accepted by this adapter.

step_size.title: Step Size
step_size.description: Accepted compatibility field; not consumed by the current GenMol de-novo sampler.

unique.title: Unique
unique.description: Remove duplicate generated SMILES from the response.

genmol.title: GenerateRequest
genmol.description: De-novo mask [*{minimum-maximum}], with 1 <= minimum <= maximum <= 512. The adapter passes floor((minimum + maximum) / 2) as upstream min_add_len, a minimum number of SAFE mask tokens; [*{10-20}] therefore reports minimum_mask_tokens=15. Upstream samples token length from its empirical distribution above that minimum. Neither endpoint is a heavy-atom bound, and maximum is not a maximum token or molecular-size limit. Measure and filter heavy-atom counts on returned SMILES separately if required. Range order and finite numeric strings are checked by the runtime.

smi.title: Smi
smi.description: Starting molecule as a valid SMILES string.

algorithm.title: Algorithm
algorithm.description: Actual adaptive CMA-ES with the requested fixed population and iterations.

property_name.title: Property Name
property_name.description: The hosted MolMIM optimizer targets QED only.

minimize.title: Minimize
minimize.description: Guide search toward lower QED and sort ascending; improvement over the starting molecule is not guaranteed.

min_similarity.title: Min Similarity
min_similarity.description: Hard final-output Morgan/Tanimoto similarity cutoff. It is also used in the soft CMA-ES objective; the hard output filter is stricter than upstream's soft-only score.

particles.title: Particles
particles.description: CMA-ES population size, at least two; part of the exact decode budget.

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.description: Requested CMA-ES ask/tell updates; no automatic increase on exhaustion.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Multiplier of the initial CMA-ES sigma 0.75; not a guaranteed chemical-distance radius.

molmim.title: GenerateRequest
molmim.description: The search uses exactly particles * iterations model decodes and never silently expands this budget. num_molecules must not exceed that product; the runtime enforces this cross-field constraint. Finite-search exhaustion is not proof of chemical infeasibility. QED is a descriptor, not efficacy.
